newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian man said to kill infant with needles.
newsitem.headline: Colombian man said to kill infant with needles.

text.p: A Colombian man enraged by his year-old stepchild's crying silenced him forever by driving two needles through his heart, local news reports said on Wednesday.

El Tiempo, Colombia's leading daily, said the child died in a hospital intensive care unit on Saturday in the northwest city of Medellin after surgery to remove sewing needles plunged into his heart by stepfather Franklin Alonso Olmos.
Alonso Olmos was arrested in the Atlantic port city of Barranquilla where he had fled.
